ctx.x: All of 'em was with big bands and violins and these guys had all this music. They opened up a sheet of music man about 3 feet long. And, I didn't know nothin' about no music, but I didn't say anything, so. By the time they got through rehearsing, I had my part down, see. I just listened. Some thing happened in Germany ---- Any time any music was available that I had to be playing in big bands and things, I just listened. And then when I found out I couldn't do it I just turned the volume down, and be strummin' --…
